coverage_rule: Absent records remain unaudited. Graph parsing, plans, metadata validation and historical audit documents do not count as new source audit coverage. Record coverage against exact source content and explicit file/module scope; partial review is not full-file coverage.

first_module.name: storage
first_module.required_review: two independent source-review passes with explicit coverage

workstreams.purpose: Read source by module, record evidence and failure paths
Fix confirmed issues and add focused regressions
Review changes and coverage independently, including adverse cases
Identify safe simplifications without losing behavior or evidence

publication.concurrency_policy: Verify expected head before update and verified commit after update. Stop and reconcile any unexpected head; never force or overwrite another writer.
